BAY PROCEDURE Tacoma RV Center · Document Library CONCERN BAL Soft-Touch SS 5.1 electric tongue jack dead. Other stabilizers and panel lights work. MODEL BAL Soft-Touch SS 5.1 DATE 2026-10-09 WO# - PRIMARY BAL Soft-Touch SS 5.1 tongue jack. Check the tongue jack output wire at the panel, then the tongue pigtail. VISUAL FLOWCHART Tongue jack only is dead. Stabilizers and panel lights work. 12V on the tongue jack output wire at the panel? Replace the soft-touch user panel 20300427. Do the tongue pigtail leads pass? Repair the tongue pigtail. Output wire and pigtail passed. Retest the tongue jack. NO YES NO YES BAY PROCEDURE Bay order · Tacoma RV Center WHAT THIS PATTERN USUALLY MEANS The electric tongue jack is the only jack that is dead. The other stabilizers still extend and retract, and the soft-touch panel lights still work. That is a check for 12V on the tongue jack output wire at the panel, then the local tongue pigtail. It is not a coupler, shear-pin, 30A fuse, or remote stabilizer harness job when the motor runs on direct 12V and the coupler is engaged. BAY ORDER (DO THIS FIRST) 1. Confirm the electric tongue jack is the only jack that is dead. The other stabilizers still extend and retract, and the soft-touch panel lights still work. Go to the tongue output-wire voltage check. 2. Press tongue extend/retract and check for 12V on the tongue jack output wire at the panel. If that wire has no 12V while the other stabilizer circuits and the lights still work, replace the soft-touch user panel 20300427. That is the confirmed correction. 3. If the tongue jack output wire has 12V, check the local tongue pigtail and the panel-to-motor leads. If voltage stops in that pigtail, repair the pigtail and retest the tongue jack. That is the confirmed correction after the panel voltage prove. 4. Use a coupler or shear-pin replacement only when the manual override will not turn, or the motor fails a direct-12V prove. When the motor runs on direct 12V and the coupler is engaged, leave the coupler installed and stay on the panel and pigtail proves. DO NOT - Do not replace the coupler or the shear pin when the other stabilizers and the panel lights work and the motor runs on direct 12V. - Do not open the 30A supply fuse or the remote stabilizer harness when only the tongue jack is dead.
